mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying a warm 79 degrees under clear skies over Fireman's Park. Tonight will be perfect for stargazing with a Waxing Crescent moon, and if you step outside at 9:31 PM, you can catch a 6-minute view of the International Space Station passing from the Northwest to the East Northeast.

In city news, Verona is continuing to promote sustainability with programs for everyone. For apartment renters, you can easily compost by utilizing the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop at 1220 East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is offering cash-back rebates for rain barrels and energy-efficient toilet upgrades to help homeowners save water and money.

There are several exciting local events coming up. On Sunday, July 19th, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Louie, or explore the annual Mount Horeb Art Fair. Looking ahead, make sure to mark your calendar for Wednesday, July 22nd, for the return of the beloved Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

In police news, officers handled several incidents this past week. Notably, on Wednesday, July 9th, at 10:30 AM, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash with minor injuries at the intersection of County Highway PB and American Way, where a 16-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield the right-of-way.

Wrap up your evening with a trip to our local Culver's for today's Flavor of the Day, Turtle. The store is open until 10:00 PM tonight, giving you three hours left to grab a dish. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
